name: Chicken Saloona with Wild Rice

components.name: Chicken Saloona
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy pot and soften onion, garlic and chopped coriander.
Stir in chicken, tomato sauce, dried limes, spice mix and stock powder; sauté 4 to 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, marrow, chopped tomato and 2 litres measured water. Simmer until chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender, around 15 to 25 minutes.
Season with the measured salt and taste before adding more because stock powder is salty. Remove whole dried limes before eating.
Portion wild rice and chicken saloona separately and chill quickly.

components.name: Wild Rice

ingredients.name: Dry wild rice, approx raw equivalent

steps: Cook the wild rice according to packet instructions with 720 ml water; check the grain is tender, drain any excess.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source is three large portions. Wild rice quantity is the source cooked amount; raw-equivalent dry amount fixed here at ~240 g (estimated for 4 cups cooked).
Storing & reheating: Freeze saloona and wild rice separately. Courgette/marrow will soften after thawing.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

foodSafety: Refrigerate in shallow containers promptly: within 2 hours of cooking, or within 1 hour if room temperature exceeds 32 C.
Store at 4 C or colder for no more than 3-4 days; freeze portions intended for later in the week.
Cook chicken and reheat leftovers thoroughly to 74 C. Ground pork must reach at least 71 C before serving; food-safe reheating still requires 74 C.
Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
